messages.subject: This application currently has no logs
parts:
I updated my app on shinyapps.io.  Changed the appName and tried the same rsconnect::deployApp(...) 3 or 4 times before it finally changed the appName.  But now, I do not see any log output.  I go to the app dashboard on shinyapps.io, press the Logs tab and see the message: This application currently has no logs.  The same thing is happening on RStudio console with rsconnect::showLogs(...).
I have many messages that track the progress of the app with cat(file=stderr, ... ).  This still works fine on RStudio, but on shinyapps.io: no log output??
